text:
maya: noticed a spike in GPU node bootstrap failures in eu-west-2 after today's firewall apply. nodes report KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied. anyone see the TF diff?
trent: yeah, looked into it. the egress rule for keystore proxies was tightened from 10.2.0.0/16 to a set of more restrictive /28s. we missed a handful of proxy IPs in az-b.
kai: concrete failure from node boot: "keystore: dial tcp 10.2.11.9:443: i/o timeout". proxy IP 10.2.11.9 is outside the new allowed /28s.
maya: opening INC-6018, paging ops-oncall. this is blocking warmpool joins and delaying deploys.
ops-oncall: got it. emergency mitigation: add temporary egress for gpu-subnets -> 10.2.0.0/16:443. request quick approval to change SG.
trent: emergency approved by sec oncall. apply manual rule and then reconcile with TF PR.
ops-oncall: running cli now:
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-gpu-provisioning --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.2.0.0/16 --region eu-west-2
```
ops-oncall: rule added, monitoring warmpool.
kai: nodes are starting to rejoin, warmpool +5 within 3 minutes. provisioning backlog draining. :relieved:
telemetry-bot: detected missing keystore.decrypt audit events 2026-03-23T14:02:00 to 2026-03-23T14:18:00 in eu-west-2. logged SIEM-1342 for re-ingest.
maya: FYI we had autoscaler fallbacks in us-east pulling model shards; telemetry shows ~750GB cross-region egress, est cost +$1.1k. record for RCA.
trent: pushed PR to firewall repo that restores a /16 superset rule and adds explicit per-AZ allow lists and a unit test that simulates KMS handshake from a GPU canary: https://git.internal/rw/firewall/pull/988
kai: also proposing a terraform preflight that resolves proxy hostnames and verifies CIDR superset before apply (INFRA-498). filing ticket.
ops-oncall: INC-6018 mitigated. will keep incident open until SIEM confirms backfill and PR merges. updating incident and SIEM tickets.
maya: thanks team. follow-ups: PR review, INFRA-498, cost calc for retro, and add an automated smoke from each AZ in rollout jobs.
trent: noted. closing monitoring alert when SIEM backfill done. :thumbsup:
